mission: Evidence-first extraction taxonomy for 100 pre-1930 US-public-domain editions.

families.description: Reusable event, reveal, reversal, escalation, or consequence sequence.
Reusable speech act or conversational move grounded in explicit dialogue or address.
Reusable goal, contradiction, mask, wound, role, relationship, or change pattern.
Competing forces, obligations, interests, or power asymmetries.
Narrative delivery architecture such as frame, diary, trial, letters, episodic journey, or nested tale.
Story-functional context; subtype is required and must be one of the listed values.

contextual_subtypes.setting: Place or environmental constraint that changes action.
contextual_subtypes.object: Material or symbolic thing whose handling changes stakes.
contextual_subtypes.transformation: Identity, status, body, allegiance, or worldview change.
contextual_subtypes.tone_pressure: Reusable emotional or tonal pressure, not a vague mood label.

acceptance_falsifiers: cross-source synthesis citing fewer than 3 distinct works
full source text or long quotation present
